# Erdos.p1072 — Erdős problem 1072

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/1072
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/1072.lean`, theorem `erdos_1072.variants.littleo`, AMS 11).

Erdős, Hardy, and Subbarao [HaSu02], believed that the number of $p \le x$ for which $f(p)=p−1$
is $o(x/\log x)$.

[HaSu02] Hardy, G. E. and Subbarao, M. V., _A modified problem of Pillai and some related questions._
Amer. Math. Monthly (2002), 554--559.

## Statement
(fun x ↦ (({p | p.Prime ∧ f p = p - 1} ∩ Icc 0 x).ncard : ℝ)) =o[atTop]
      (fun x ↦ x / Real.log x)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
